2026-09-29 initial research checked APH/frozen chronology, Homes for Homes May 2022 employer release, Nappy Collective May 2025 departure release, FCAV 2024–2025 annual report, Property Council 2021 first-person profile and Good Samaritan July 2025 interview; JOY interview introduction adds ballet studio lead.

Targeted employer-name searches did not corroborate them, so these remain leads, not accepted employer spells or dates. US Northern Trust executive and UnitedHealth family-member namesakes excluded.

Official November 2017–July 2023 partnership and December 2021–May 2025 CEO periods overlap. Contemporaneous 2022 employer material independently supports the first role during overlap; do not assume two full-time posts or erase the discrepancy. Exact hours and any leave remain unknown.

A first-speech debate page included multiple members and did not supply additional verified early employer detail. Charity annual-report link for 2023–2024 was located but departure release and FCAV annual report supplied the relevant initial primary evidence. Follow older reports/archived career material on later pass.
Missing pre-2017 dates and hours cannot become zeros or a synthetic continuous career. Last follow-up 2026-09-29; retain blocked status and detailed leads for systematic national follow-up.
